title: Mapper database credentials
description: The environment keys a generated mapper reads when it pushes device readings into a database. Every key is optional: a mapper reads only the one its configured push target needs.

PASSWORD.description: Password for the Redis, MySQL or TDengine client the mapper was generated with. Secret: the value never enters the catalog.

USERNAME.description: User name for the TDengine client. Secret by association: it is supplied through the same channel as the password and is not written in a device resource.

TOKEN.description: Write token for the InfluxDB 2 client. Secret: the value never enters the catalog.
